## Decision

<a id="DocumentForm"></a>

### How a document is stored

`DocumentForm` · `src/documents.ts:52`

Its value and the version of the description it is of, as two members of a JSON object; what is stored without them (written before versions were kept) is the value itself, of the first version deployed.

| Case | Value |
|---|---|
| version | version |
| value | value |

- Decided by: trame
- Used by: [Documents kept in the preferences](#DocumentsInPreferences), [Documents kept in the preferences](scenarios.md#DocumentsKept)

<a id="Conforms"></a>

### A value of the description it is of

`Conforms` · `src/documents.ts:63` · status: **held**

A value stored is checked against the description, field by field: a text, a number that is finite, yes or no, a calendar date, a word of its vocabulary, the key of another entity, a list of such, or nothing where it is optional. A member that no field describes is not part of it.

<a id="DocumentsInPreferences"></a>

### Documents kept in the preferences

`DocumentsInPreferences` · `src/documents.ts:124` · status: **held**

A document is kept in the preferences of the device, under the entity's name, as JSON: its version and its value. Read, it is migrated from the version it was stored with, then checked; what cannot be read, migrated or checked is nothing, and the product does as if nothing were kept.

<a id="Migrate"></a>

### A value migrated

`Migrate` · `src/documents.ts:95` · status: **held**

A value stored with a version deployed becomes one of the description as it is, by the steps the entity computed from the two: a field added takes its value, one renamed moves, one dropped goes, one filled takes its value where it has none. A version nothing migrates from (newer than the description, or unknown) gives nothing.

- Owner: trame
- Body: inline, in the declaration
- Serves: [Data described once](product.md#DataDescribedOnce)
